name: Tainted Chakra (Akashic)
body:
Your chakra is tainted with the energy of some dark entity or shadowed bloodline, giving your veils and essence abilities a sinister cast.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to shape veils.

Benefit(s): You can shape veils with the [evil] descriptor regardless of your alignment. You gain a +1 profane bonus on the save DCs of such veils and increase any profane bonuses normally offered by such veils by +1.
